platformCpu.label: Platform base - CPU (Edge OS, runtime, management agent)
platformCpu.basis: FIELD: Client 1 device total 6.25% x 4 cores = 0.25 core-eq, minus ~0.13 attributable to its apps = ~0.12 left for the OS/runtime.

platformRamGb.label: Platform base - RAM
platformRamGb.basis: ESTIMATE. Host memory on Client 1 was 1.6 GB in use with ~2.2 GB of app memory reported, so little is left for the OS.

platformStorageGb.label: Platform base - storage
platformStorageGb.basis: FIELD: Client 1 used 8.8 GB in total; Client 2 24.9 GB. After subtracting the apps (Field Data sheet) ~1-6 GB remains for the OS.

headroom.label: Design headroom
headroom.basis: ENGINEERING CHOICE (reduced from 30% on request - 'a little headroom'). Applied to CPU, storage and data rate.

bytesPerSample.label: Bytes per stored sample (compressed)
bytesPerSample.basis: ESTIMATE. Value + timestamp + quality after time-series compression.

winccCpuBase.label: WinCC Unified runtime - base CPU
winccCpuBase.basis: FIELD-CALIBRATED: Client 2 device load is 2.14 core-eq (18.9% x 6 cores x 1.89) but its apps only account for ~0.4. The remainder (~1.7) is attributed to WinCC Unified + HMI clients because it is the main difference from Client 1. The WinCC app page itself shows only 0.39%, so VERIFY on a live system.

winccCpuPerClient.label: WinCC Unified - CPU per concurrent web client

winccRamPerClientGb.label: WinCC Unified - RAM per concurrent web client

winccCpuPer1000Tags.label: WinCC Unified - CPU per 1,000 tags
winccCpuPer1000Tags.basis: ESTIMATE. Siemens manual test: 6,000 tags published from 5 PLCs on an IPC227E with 3 HMI screens, no data loss.

memoryReservationFactor.label: Memory-limit reservation factor
memoryReservationFactor.basis: FIELD+DOC: the Industrial Edge 'Memory Limit Check' compares the sum of each app's RESERVED/limit memory with 90% of device RAM. Client 1 reserves 5.9 GB for ~2.2 GB of real use (2.7x); Client 2 8.0 GB for ~3.7 GB (2.1x). RAM pass/fail uses actual x this factor.

dataRatePerCoreEq.label: Data-rate ceiling per core-equivalent
dataRatePerCoreEq.basis: DOC-DERIVED: Siemens tested 40,000 value changes/s on an IPC427E (4 cores x index 1.13 = 4.5 core-eq) = ~8,900 per core-eq; 8,000 used.
